description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and constants for managing a reference cache in a version control system, likely Git. It includes structures for reference directories, reference entries, and cache management, as well as functions for creating, freeing, and iterating over reference caches.

methods.name: create_ref_cache
methods.description: Creates a new reference cache, optionally with a fill function for lazy loading directories.

methods.name: free_ref_cache
methods.description: Frees the reference cache and all associated data.

methods.name: add_entry_to_dir
methods.description: Adds a reference entry to a reference directory.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Starts iteration over references in the cache, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: search_ref_dir
methods.description: Searches for a reference by name within a reference directory.

methods.name: create_dir_entry
methods.description: Creates a reference directory entry for a given directory name.

methods.name: create_ref_entry
methods.description: Creates a new reference entry with specified name, referent, object ID, and flags.

methods.name: get_ref_dir
methods.description: Retrieves the reference directory associated with a reference entry.
